questions.question: What denominator appears in conditional probability?
questions.needle: P(A | B) = P(A and B) / P(B), provided P(B) > 0.

questions.question: What is updated after observing evidence?
questions.needle: A prior probability is updated after observing evidence.

questions.question: How is independence defined?
questions.needle: Events A and B are independent when P(A and B) = P(A) P(B).
